slides.title: What a *matatu* gets right about branding.
You know it from far away.
slides.body: The colours, the art, the name on the side. You can spot your favourite before you can read the route.

slides.title: It has a personality.
slides.body: The music, the graffiti, the attitude. People pick a matatu for how it makes them feel.

slides.title: People talk about it.
slides.body: The best ones have fans who post them online for free. That's word of mouth on wheels.

slides.title: Is your brand as easy to *spot?*

caption:
Nairobi's matatus are some of the best branding in the country.

You can recognise your favourite from across the road. It has a personality you can feel. And people share photos of it online without being paid.

That's what a strong brand does: it gets noticed, it gets felt and it gets talked about.

Could a stranger spot your business from across the road? DM us "SPOT".
